about:
# Readycheck

The complete character toolkit for WoW Classic: reminders, consumables, gear
and trinket swaps, world buffs, raid setups, time-to-kill and more.
Runs on Classic Era, TBC Anniversary and WoW Forever.

Type **/rc** in game to open it.

## Install

The easy way is an addon app that keeps it up to date for you:
**CurseForge**, **WowUp** or **Wago**.

By hand: download the zip from the newest release, and put
every `Readycheck*` folder inside it into
`World of Warcraft\_classic_era_\Interface\AddOns` (or the `_anniversary_`
folder for TBC). Restart the game.

## Updates

Addon apps update Readycheck for you. In game, Readycheck tells you once
per session when someone in your guild or group has a newer version.

## Problems or ideas

Open an issue and say what you did, what you expected, and
any error text you saw.

releases.notes:
## Readycheck 5.0.15 - The website's new address

### Changed
- The website has a new address: zacaddons.com. The report, suggest and website buttons, /rc report, /rc suggest and the route planner link now open it.

## Readycheck 5.0.14 - A tidier settings window, and a website for reports and ideas

### Added
- Readycheck has a website: what changed in every version, bug reports and feature suggestions. /rc report and /rc suggest give you the link with your version filled in. So do the buttons under Need help? on the General page and the headset button beside Discord and Twitch.
- Gold: pick whose gold counts, on the stats bar's Gold tab. Every account in your mesh is listed. An account on another Battle.net counts once each of the two accounts ticks the other, and a tick carries to your other accounts on the same Battle.net. An account on your Battle.net that is not yours can be unticked.

### Changed
- The group pages (Reminders, Consumables, Gear and the rest) have a new look: each feature is a raised tile with its state, its switch and an In menu tick that takes its page out of the menu on the left.
- Dropdown lists are as wide as their longest choice, so nothing in an open list is cut short.
- Appearance: the window preview shows the settings window as it looks today.

### Fixed
- Searching the settings made the game stutter. It no longer does.
- Settings window: text that did not show or was cut short on many pages, among them the description lines on the Sound tab, the Icon look picker, the raid profile box and smart macro lines.
- Raid pages and the Custom Reminders page were missing their title.
- Dropdown lists opened bigger or smaller than their box when the settings window was not at 100%.
- Thin lines in the settings window came and went as it scrolled on some screens.
- Raid Buff Tracker and Boss Debuff Tracker: the time and the word MISSING were cut short. When a name and MISSING do not both fit, missing rows show an X.
- Battle Shout tracker: long names were cut short.
- Reminder icons and Raid Consume Reminders: a label wider than its icon was cut short.
- World Buff Drops: your own character's row showed only "(you)", and a long name from another realm ran into the level column.
- World buff board: the Stored and Ready captions were cut short.
- Flask of the Titans, Spirit of Zanza and the Missing Buff Alert preset showed a blank icon.

## Readycheck 5.0.13 - Cooldowns after a PC restart

### Fixed
- A cooldown that began before your PC was restarted could show as a full cooldown on trinket, consumable and item timers. It shows the time really left.

## Readycheck 5.0.12 - Gear by spec and stance, and a size for every piece on screen

### Added
- Gear Manager, Spec & Stance: say which specs and stances or forms each gear set and item is for, and the dockable buttons' menus list only what fits what you are doing. For every class. Off until you turn it on.
- Gear sets can go on by themselves when your stance, form or spec changes. In a fight the swap waits for the fight to end, and a rule's Macro button makes one key that changes stance and weapons together. Off until you turn it on.
- One size for everything Readycheck puts on screen: the Size slider in move mode.
- Move mode: each piece has its own size. Pick a piece to change its scale, or its width, height, icon size and spacing.
- Appearance: borders can be a hairline or grow with the UI scale.

### Changed
- Borders and thin lines are one screen pixel wide at every UI scale.

### Fixed
- Reminders, dock buttons and other pieces could draw over the open world map. They go behind it now and come back when it closes.
- Songflower timers could be up to ten seconds late.
- The reminder popup's icon size and spacing apply at once, and move mode shows the popup at its real size.
- Changing a piece's Scale on its page moved the piece. It stays in place.

## Readycheck 5.0.11 - Icon sizes for nameplate debuffs

### Added
- Nameplates: each debuff group has its own icon size, and icon rows have a setting for the space between icons. Until you set one, the icon follows the text size as before.

### Fixed
- An error at login when another addon's copy of a shared library was broken. The minimap button loads anyway.
